Messages.Author: Merlin
Messages.Body:
Clio's Kiss
Type: Action
Requires: Temporis/Dominate
Cost: 1 blood
+1 stealth action.
[dom] (D) Burn 1 pool from a Methuselah who is contesting a card with
you.
[tem] Exchange any card in your hand for any non-master, non-unique
library card in your ash heap.
[TEM] (D) Choose a vampire card another Methuselah is contesting with
you. That Methuselah yields that copy. If there are no other
Methuselahs contesting the vampire, place your copy of the vampire face
up in your controlled region, untapped.

So...with the TEM version, can a True Brujah burn a contested imbued? I
would guess the answer is no, but this one has no official declaration
on the NoR preview page. "Vampire" in the text seems pretty explicit,
but, hey, it's a card printed prior to NoR, so it could be yes.

LSJ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

No, indeed.

The identity of a contested card is known.
